scenarios.message: My sister is a huge Wes Anderson fan and has Radiohead on repeat. Budget $50.
Gift for a friend who's all about Kendrick Lamar, around $130.
My husband sinks hours into Elden Ring and rereads Tolkien every winter. Up to $70.
Coworker loves Blade Runner and Daft Punk, keep it under $45.
My dad practically lives in Patagonia fleeces and goes camping every month. Budget $250.
My son rewatches Interstellar and every Denis Villeneuve film. $40 max.
